This used to be a big, thriving great value fish store. I worked here on weekends until about 10 years ago when I became a parent. I went back to visit and it looks like an empty husk of its prior glory.  They have so little livestock & pet supplies it looks like they are about to close. People tell me it's been like this for a couple of years. I think they need to rename it "Abandoned City Pets".

Was not really surprised with my experience today. Before coming in, I browsed over some reviews just to see if the store was worth the visit. Majority of the reviews were things i experienced. this was one of many pet stores that i was looking at to get a bunny. out of all stores, this was in last place.  entering the store the place seemed so dark for  what us suppose to be housing lively animals.
Customer service is just poor. after walking in, had a couple employees pass by and not say a word to me. after browsing for a minute, i went to get an employee and they didn't seem too happy to help me. asked them to go inside their bird cage area. held one bunny and didn't feel like it was the one for me, so i asked to hold another bunny, the guy told me that he was only going to let me hold one??? told me it was a policy. sounded like the dumbest policy ever if it even is one. the point of a pet store is to allow you to find the animal that you will home forever, why would i be limited to only holding one?? i asked him, "is that really a policy" and he laughed in my face and said yes. highly doubt that it was and he just didn't want to help me out. if he believed that i wasn't holding the animal correctly, then he defiantly should have educated me on that. i don't even think that was the reason though. also, while holding it, asked the gender of the bunny, employee didn't know. i would think they would separate the bunnies by gender so that it's easier to tell but i might be wrong on doing that. also there were two small cages out of 3 that had about 8/10 bunnies. other stores had the genders separated and had about 5/6 bunnies with cages three times larger. i would think for a business that has been open for 38years they would have a larger cage for the amount of bunnies. i'm going back thursday to see if the policy is real by asking a different employee and hopefully giving this place another try. truly disappointed. price of the bunnies were similar to all the other stores and i don't know too much about bunnies so im not too sure about the health of the bunnies.
